content: In #37734, we shall make SimplexCategory a one-field structure containing a field in ℕ. This will make ⦋n⦌.len = n a syntactic identify. This means that the lemma len_mk is no longer necessary: there will be some breakage in downstream code for some invocations of dsimp or simp only [len_mk]. Hopefully, it should not be too bad when updating mathlib in the infinity-cosmos project. (In the whole mathlib, very few fixes were necessary.)
Thanks for the heads up. Does anyone want to try to bump the infinity cosmos project now that this is merged?

I started a mathlib bump at https://github.com/emilyriehl/infinity-cosmos/pull/167. There are three files that have errors/sorries that still need to be fixed: Quasicategory/TwoTruncated, InfinityCosmos/Goals, and InfinityCosmos/Isofibration. I haven't looked in detail, everything else was straightforward
Now only some errors towards the end of the TwoTruncated file need to be fixed. The issue is that ReflQuiv.adj was refactored.
